output.headline: Open-platform sponsor with 7 adjacent provider deals and a 15.5x median paid; the $200M Midwest target fits as an add-on at its usual deal size.
output.differentiator: One of few sponsors on the priority list with an open platform for an add-on route, and it pays a median 15.5x, above the 12.8x comparable median.
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform; pays above the comparable median

acquirer_overview.title: A global sponsor with 18 deals since 2016 and a strong close rate
points: Financial sponsor with 18 deals from 2016 to 2024; 15 of 18 (83%) closed and 17 of 18 (94%) were control deals [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Raised Advent Global Private Equity X, about $25 billion (2022 vintage), and reports approximately $100 billion AUM as of November 2025 [P:1, P:2].
Deals range from $14M to $5,537M with a median of $124M; 8 of 18 sit in the $100M-$400M band [T:record, K:size_band].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Sector relevance is a modest factor in its likelihood: 1 deal in the target's sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors [S:sector_rel, T:record].
Its open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on rather than a new bet, and size fit is a stated angle [A:angles].
Margin Improvement is its most frequent distinguishing motive, in 7 of 18 deals, relevant to a target with a 16.8% margin [M:margin_improvement, X:target].

precedent_activity.title: Same-sub-sector deal in 2024 and a behavioral health base
points: Crest Care Partners: $304M recapitalization in 2024, same sub-sector as the target, at 9.3x EV/EBITDA [D:MA-2024-0120].
Crown Addiction Treatment: $123M recapitalization in 2023 at 14.6x. Principal Counseling: $163M minority investment in 2021 (Great Plains) at 13.2x [D:MA-2023-0108, D:MA-2021-0341].
Summit DSO: $303M merger of equals in 2018, its one Midwest deal, at 11.7x [D:MA-2018-0184].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, but the return at the ask is tight
points: 70 comparable deals show EV/EBITDA of 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comparables' median of 12.9%, supporting the 75th percentile; Advent's own median paid is 15.5x [V:comps].
At the ask, IRR is 18.7% against a 20% target; maximum price is $193M on the same exit and $216M on a platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites the add-on exit; the same-exit ceiling of $193M is below $200M [V:lbo, X:target].

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest footprint
risk_flags.concern: Prior purchases in this or a neighbouring region are a slight factor against; it has 1 deal in the target's region [S:geo_fit, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Summit DSO (Midwest, 2018) and Principal Counseling (Great Plains, 2021) show regional experience [D:MA-2018-0184, D:MA-2021-0341].
risk_flags.reality: Geographic expansion motivated 13 of 18 deals, so a new region is familiar ground [M:geographic_expansion].

risk_flags.title: Competing platform sponsors
risk_flags.concern: Nordic Capital and Welsh Carson, also open-platform sponsors on the priority list, can pursue the same add-on [R:rank].
risk_flags.mitigant: Advent's median paid of 15.5x sits above the comparable median of 12.8x [V:comps].
risk_flags.reality: It closed 15 of 18 deals (83%); price will decide the process [K:closed_share].

conviction.rationale: 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus an open platform in the sub-sector giving an add-on route [C:conviction, T:record, A:angles].
